put.description:
The technical name and type cannot be changed, so columns keep referring to the same format.
This endpoint requires admin access

delete.description:
Columns that use it keep their values and are reported as broken. When columns use the format, the request has to confirm how many: without that number it answers 409 with it. Formats shipped with Tables cannot be deleted, only disabled.
This endpoint requires admin access

parameters.name: confirmBrokenColumns
parameters.description: Number of columns that will break, as the 409 response gave it

parameters.name: OCS-APIRequest
parameters.description: Required to be true for the API request to pass

409.description: Columns use the format and their number was not confirmed

403.description: Logged in account must be an admin

post.summary: [api v2] Preview a change to a format
post.description:
Shows how many columns use the format and how many of their stored values would fail the changed definition, without storing it. Stored values stay readable after the change, but writes of failing values are refused.
This endpoint requires admin access
